title: Autonomy-first recovery and resumable scoped decisions

spec.problem: Recoverable local environment failures can currently satisfy BLOCKED, and consequential decisions have no durable resumable execution state.

acceptance.text: AUTO/DECISION_REQUIRED/FORBIDDEN action policy preserves all existing quality gates and fingerprints.
Durable recovery evidence rejects local missing/stopped tooling as immediate BLOCKED and retries the original goal after verified recovery.
Identity-bound ONCE/TASK/WORKSPACE_CLASS decisions use native question, permission, then structured fallback and preserve WAITING_FOR_DECISION continuation.
Hook and CLI adversarial tests cover cases A-K, guard bypass/secret exposure, stale identity, pending close, cancellation alternatives, and existing lifecycle regressions.

spec.expected_behavior: Recover safe local failures autonomously, require identity-bound consequential decisions, resume the suspended action, and reserve BLOCKED for exhausted external recovery.
spec.observed_behavior: A stopped local runtime can be reported BLOCKED after one failed alternative; safe recovery and scoped interactive continuation are absent.

classification.rationale: Recoverable local environment failures and missing durable consequential-decision continuation are harness defects; quality gates remain intact.
